anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius, broad convex curve forming a bulbous forehead typical of a rounded cranial profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, low-aspect ratio beak protruding minimally from the anterior melon base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle visible at the transition point between the steep melon slope and the dorsal surface of the short rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, thin horizontal linear scar is visible across the central light-colored flank region; a small, dark, circular pigmentation spot or lesion is present ventral to the linear scar.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, large-scale white lateral patch against a dark teal/grey dorsal and ventral body coloration.
